about_short_description.short_description: Beglaubigt.de (https://beglaubigt.de) ist eine Plattform, die sich auf die Beglaubigung & Automatisierung von Dokumenten spezialisiert hat.

product.name: Digital Notarization Service
product.description: A platform enabling users to have documents notarized digitally within 48 hours, including identity verification and secure document delivery.

product.name: Online Company Formation (GmbH/UG)
product.description: A digital service for founding German limited liability companies (GmbH/UG) including document preparation, notarial certification, and registration.

product.name: Certified Document Translation Service
product.description: A service providing legally certified translations of official documents by sworn translators, delivered digitally or by post.

product.name: Notary Appointment and Coordination Platform
product.description: A digital platform that facilitates finding, booking, and managing notary appointments across multiple German cities, including remote and express options.

product.name: Legal Document Creation Tool (Loan Agreement)
product.description: An online tool to create legally compliant, customizable loan agreements in PDF or Word format.
